title: 第2331章 回味小夫妻带娃的感觉第2330章 享受双亲的疼爱
content_zh:
白莲神宗宗主峰
享受娘亲做的美食后，郑风甜甜地被娘亲诓睡着了。
“夫人，风儿睡着了，还是放床上去吧！”
灵嫣然摸了摸郑风的脸，仔细端详，良久，看了看夫君郑钰郎。很认真的说道：“夫君，直到今天才发现，风儿长得太像你了！”
“夫人说笑了，为夫是的儿子长得像为夫不是很正常吗？”
郑钰郎笑着打趣。
“我辛辛苦苦生的儿子不应该更像我才对吗？”
灵嫣然问得一本正经，郑钰郎一愣神，反应过来后宽慰道：“如果夫人再给为夫生个二宝三宝，或许长得太像你了！”
灵嫣然黛眉微蹙，有些无奈。
“要是没有二宝三宝那不是亏大了？”
“所以我们更应该多多努力造娃，生个和娘子一样漂亮的二宝三宝四宝，五宝六宝七宝。”
郑钰郎嘴上没把门，一下子刹不住，脸上还有一些兴奋。
灵嫣然一巴掌打在郑钰郎高高鼓起的屁屁上，很结实，弹性极好！不由得笑道：“你以为生猪仔呢？一生生一窝，还一二三四五六七八九！看把你能的！”
郑钰郎俯身把脸凑到灵嫣然鼻尖下
，嬉皮笑脸地反驳道：“为夫刚才没数那么多？只数到七宝！”
“别闹，风儿还在睡觉呢，被吵醒了！”
郑风没有听到自己娘亲和父亲的对话，在灵嫣然怀里睡得沉沉的。父亲郑玉郎将其抱起，缓步走到床前，轻轻地放到床边上。
“放那么靠边，也不担心风儿翻个身滚下来？”
灵嫣然纤纤玉手一抬，轻轻地将郑风放到了床榻正中间。
“这下好了，随便怎么翻身都不用担心滚下床！”

床足够大，之前他们夫妇二人滚床单都不嫌小。睡郑风一个人绰绰有余。
“夫人这样放，晚点我们怎么睡？”
郑钰郎有些疑惑的问道。
“夫君睡风儿左边！”
“夫人睡风儿右边？”
“宝宝睡中间不是很合理吗？”
灵嫣然很自然地就挨着郑风躺下了。纤纤玉手轻轻抚摸郑风的脸，还在郑风额头上轻轻的亲了一口。
郑钰郎很是无奈，“夫人，娘子，为夫也要亲亲！”
灵嫣然看笑着打闹邀宠的夫君，抬起身
也在夫君郑钰郎额头上，蜻蜓点水般的亲了一下。
郑钰郎有些不依不饶，“不够，不够，还要！还要！”
夫妇二人隔着宝贝儿子郑风就那样没羞没躁的亲了一下又一下。好在郑风睡得很沉，不然头顶一定会发光发热发烫。
月上柳梢头，宗主峰上静悄悄，郑钰郎一家三口像凡俗之家一样，夫妇二人带娃，宝宝睡中间，灵嫣然搂着郑风，郑钰郎搂着娘俩，三人都是幸福感爆棚的神情，把郑风体内昊天塔里面的塔灵大哥和风雷剑妹妹看得一愣一愣的。
“两位尊上和小少主这是在回味小夫妻带娃的光景？！”
“一家三口和和睦睦甜甜蜜蜜，羡煞旁人！”
“这样的画面虽然很温馨，但还是不能让其他人看到。”
昊天塔塔灵大哥屏蔽了昊天塔内的一切生灵对外的查探。
风雷剑剑灵妹妹笑道：“早该如此！要是两位尊上一会儿反应过来，发现你看了不该看的，嘿嘿！”
昊天塔塔灵大哥猛然惊醒，吓出了一身冷汗！
content_en:
The main peak of the White Lotus Sect
After enjoying the delicious food made by his mother, Zheng Feng was sweetly tricked into falling asleep by his mother.
"Madam, Feng'er is asleep, so let's put him on the bed!"
Ling Yanran touched Zheng Feng's face, looked at it carefully, and looked at her husband Zheng Yulang for a long time. He said seriously: "Husband, I didn't realize until today that Feng'er looks so much like you!"
"Madam, you are joking. Isn't it normal for my husband's son to look like me?"
Zheng Yulang joked with a smile.
"Shouldn't the son I worked so hard to give birth to be more like me?"
Ling Yanran asked seriously, and Zheng Yulang was stunned for a moment. After he realized what he was doing, he said with relief, "If Madam gives birth to a second child and a third child for her husband, maybe she will look too much like you!"
Ling Yanran frowned slightly, feeling helpless.
"If we don't have the second and third treasures, wouldn't it be a big loss?"
"So we should work harder to create a baby, and give birth to a second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth and seventh child as beautiful as our wife."
Zheng Yulang didn't hold the door shut, he couldn't stop for a moment, and there was still some excitement on his face.
Ling Yanran slapped Zheng Yulang's bulging butt. It was very strong and extremely elastic! He couldn't help but laugh and said: "What do you think of giving birth to piglets? You will give birth to a litter in a lifetime, and you will get one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine! See what you can do!"
Zheng Yulang leaned over and put his face under Ling Yanran's nose
, retorted with a playful smile: "Husband, you didn't count that many just now? You only counted the seven treasures!"
"Don't make trouble, Feng'er is still sleeping, he was woken up!"
Zheng Feng didn't hear the conversation between his mother and father, and fell asleep deeply in Ling Yanran's arms. His father Zheng Yulang picked him up, walked slowly to the bed, and gently placed him on the edge of the bed.
"If you put it so close to the side, you won't worry about it turning over in the wind?"
Ling Yanran raised her slender hand and gently placed Zheng Feng in the middle of the bed.
"It's okay now, you can turn over any time without worrying about rolling out of bed!"
The bed was big enough for the couple to sleep on the bed before. It's more than enough to sleep with Zheng Feng alone.
"Ma'am, if you leave it like this, how can we sleep later?"
Zheng Yulang asked with some confusion.
"Husband, sleep on Feng'er's left side!"
"Ma'am, do you sleep on Feng'er's right side?"
"Isn't it reasonable for the baby to sleep in the middle?"
Ling Yanran naturally lay down next to Zheng Feng. She gently touched Zheng Feng's face with her slender hands, and kissed Zheng Feng gently on his forehead.
Zheng Yulang was very helpless, "Madam, my wife, even if you are your husband, you must kiss me!"
Ling Yanran looked at her husband who was laughing and playing around, and raised her body
He also kissed her husband Zheng Yulang on his forehead like a dragonfly.
Zheng Yulang was a little reluctant, "Not enough, not enough, more! More!"
The couple kissed each other again and again without shame or impatience, across their precious son Zheng Feng. Fortunately, Zheng Feng slept very deeply, otherwise the top of his head would have been glowing and hot.
In the moonlight above the willow trees, it was quiet on the sect leader's peak. Zheng Yulang's family of three looked like an ordinary family. The couple was raising their baby, and the baby was sleeping in the middle. Ling Yanran was hugging Zheng Feng, and Zheng Yulang was hugging his mother and father. The three of them had expressions of overwhelming happiness, and the elder brother Ta Ling and younger sister Fenglei Jian in the Haotian Tower inside Zheng Feng's body were stunned.
"Are your two lords and young master reminiscing about the scene of a young couple raising a baby?!"
"The three members of the family live in harmony and sweetness, which makes others envious!"
"Although such a scene is very heartwarming, it cannot be seen by others."
The eldest brother of the Haotian Tower has blocked all creatures in the Haotian Tower from outside inspection.
The sister of Fenglei Sword and Sword Spirit smiled and said: "It should have been like this! If the two lords react in a while and find that you have seen something you shouldn't have seen, hehe!"
The eldest brother of the Haotian Tower suddenly woke up and broke into a cold sweat!
